Have you gotten your flu shot yet? Community Flu Shot Clinics are coming. Schedule yours today.
October 20 in New York Mills, and October 28 and November 4 in Fergus Falls.
Appointments are quick and easy to schedule; make yours now .
Calling all residential and commercial contractors !
The Otter Tail County HRA is looking for local contractors to bid on projects, including women-owned, minority-owned, and Section 3 businesses.
If your business is rehab business, contact us !
Curious about fostering?
Visit our Child Foster Care website to learn more about the process of becoming a foster parent.
Change a child’s life…and your own!
The scariest threats this October aren’t lurking in the shadows. In Otter Tail County, fall brings longer nights and more time spent indoors and online , and that’s exactly when cyber criminals do their haunting.
Make sure your digital life is protected before something truly scary shows up at your door.
